newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian H1 coal output declines six pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russian H1 coal output declines six pct yr/yr.

text.p: MOSCOW, July 14 (Reuterrr) - Russia's coal output in the first half of this year slipped around six percent to 118.8 million tonnes from 127 million tonnes in the first half of 1996, the Rosugol state coal mining concern said on Monday.
Rosugol, quoted by Interfax news agency, also said output in the main Donetsk mining region fell nearly 25 percent on year-ago levels.
